answer.explanation: From 00:27:02Z to the end of the window, every Thumbnailer invocation that writes output fails with NoSuchBucket on s3:PutObject (handler.py line 43, S3.put_object(Bucket=OUTPUT_BUCKET)). The Uploader, Compression and CRUD functions log no errors in the window. NoSuchBucket means the bucket name the function resolves does not exist, not that access is denied, so IAM is not the cause. The handler code is unchanged across the failures, which points to the live OUTPUT_BUCKET value. The same NoSuchBucket error burst also occurred 21:12-21:27Z on 2026-10-22, so the bad value has been present on and off. The logs do not show the bucket name, and I had no tool to read the function's environment or the IaC template, so I could not confirm whether the wrong value is live config or came from the template.
